Weather news, August 4: 70 KM wind, heavy rain and storm alert in 17 states for next 13 hours, Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, UP, Bihar, Rajasthan, MP, Bengal, Jammu and Kashmir to…; check full IMD forecast here
Heavy rain, storms and powerful winds are likely in 17 states on Tuesday, August 4, as monsoon intensifies in parts of India, as per the IMD.
According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD) forecast, a warning of heavy rain and thunderstorms has been issued for 17 states, including Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and Delhi-NCR.
Rain and thunderstorm alert for Delhi-NCR, Uttar Pradesh
As per the IMD forecast for August 4, Tuesday, light to moderate rainfall accompanied by thunder and windstorms with speeds up to 35 kmph, is expected in Delhi and neighbouring NCR districts of Noida, Ghaziabad, Faridabad and Gurugram. In Uttar Pradesh, heavy rain and thunderstorm warnings have been issued for Saharanpur, Muzaffarnagar, Hardoi, Sambhal, Shahjahanpur, Bahraich, Azamgarh, Gonda, Ballia, Ambedkarnagar, Jaunpur, Mau, Ghazipur, Chandauli, Ambedkarnagar, Kheri, Pratapgarh, Sitapur, Bulandshahr, and Jyotiba Phule Nagar.
Moderate to heavy rain, windstorms in Bihar, Jharkhand
The weather department has forecast moderate t0 heavy rainfall, storms and strong winds (up to 50 kmph) over parts of Bihar, with alerts in place for West Champaran, Vaishali, West Champaran, East Champaran, Patna, Lakhisarai, Katihar, Muzaffarpur, Darbhanga, Samastipur, Madhubani, Saharsa, Supaul, and Madhubani districts. In neighbouring Jharkhand, similar alerts are active in Palamu, Ranchi, Dumka, Jamshedpur, Hazaribagh, Garhwa, Deoghar, Latehar, Saraikela, Ramgarh, Godda, and Jamtara. Strong winds will blow at speeds of 50-60 kmph during this period.
Heavy rains, storms to lash Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal
According to the IMD weather warning, heavy rain, storms and gusty winds of up to 60 kmph are expected in Jammu and Kashmir's Kathua, Udhampur, Jammu, Rajouri, Anantnag, Samba, Poonch, Ramban, Budgam, Kulgam, and Ganderbal districts on Tuesday. Meanwhile, in Himachal Pradesh, the weather office has issued a light rain and thunderstorm alert for Chamba, Kangra, Una, Shimla, Kullu, Bilaspur, Kangra, and Kinnaur, with strong winds expected to blow at speeds of 30-40 kmph.
Heavy rain alerts for West Bengal, Punjab
The weather office has issued alerts for heavy rain, thunderstorms, and winds up to 35 kmph in parts of West Bengal, including Jalpaiguri, Alipurduar, Darjeeling, and Cooch Behar districts. In Punjab, heavy rain and thunderstorm warnings have been issued for Hoshiarpur, Pathankot, Roop Nagar, Sas Nagar, Nawa Shahar, Bathinda, Muktsar, and Fazilka. Strong winds will blow at speeds of 20 to 25 kmph.
'Yellow' alert for Madhya Pradesh, heatwave in Rajasthan
A 'yellow alert' for rain has been issued in Madhya Pradesh for Satna, Guna, Ujjain, Khargone, Morena, Indore, Chhatarpur, Balaghat, Vidisha, Dewas, Mandla, Khandwa, and Chhindwara districts. Meanwhile, in Rajasthan, the IMD has issued a heatwave alert for several districts, including Jaipur, Ajmer, Kota, Bikaner, Bundi, Jhalawar, Banswara, Udaipur, Jaisalmer, Anupgarh, Alwar, Karauli, and Jodhpur, with temperatures expected to rise a few notches above normal.
